topics.title: Meaning and Concepts of National Income

concepts.name: National Income
concepts.description: National income is the total monetary value of all final goods and services produced by the normal residents of a country during an accounting year. It serves as an important indicator of a nation's economic performance.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to define national income and explain its significance in measuring economic performance.

concepts.name: Final Goods and Services
concepts.description: Final goods and services are those purchased for final consumption or investment and are not used for further production. Considering only final goods prevents double counting in national income estimation.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to distinguish between final goods and intermediate goods.

concepts.name: Circular Flow of Income
concepts.description: The circular flow of income illustrates the continuous movement of goods, services, and money between households and firms within an economy.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the basic circular flow of income in an economy.

concepts.name: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
concepts.description: GDP is the total market value of all final goods and services produced within a country's domestic territory during a given year.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to define GDP and explain its role in measuring economic activity.

concepts.name: Gross National Product (GNP) and Net National Product (NNP)
concepts.description: GNP measures the total output produced by a country's residents, while NNP is obtained by deducting depreciation from GNP, reflecting the net value of production.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to differentiate between GNP and NNP.

concepts.name: Personal Income and Disposable Income
concepts.description: Personal income refers to the income received by individuals, while disposable income is the income remaining after payment of personal taxes and is available for spending or saving.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the concepts of personal income and disposable income.

concepts.name: Production Method
concepts.description: The production or value-added method measures national income by calculating the value added at each stage of production across all sectors of the economy.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to describe the production method of measuring national income.

concepts.name: Income Method
concepts.description: The income method estimates national income by summing all factor incomes earned by land, labour, capital, and entrepreneurs during production.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the income method of national income estimation.

concepts.name: Expenditure Method
concepts.description: The expenditure method measures national income by adding total expenditure on consumption, investment, government spending, and net exports.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the expenditure method of measuring national income.

topics.title: Importance and Limitations of National Income

concepts.name: Importance of National Income
concepts.description: National income statistics help governments formulate economic policies, evaluate growth, compare living standards, and plan future development strategies.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the importance of national income in economic planning.

concepts.name: Limitations of National Income
concepts.description: National income estimates do not account for unpaid household work, informal economic activities, environmental degradation, or income inequality.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify the major limitations of national income as an economic indicator.

concepts.name: Per Capita Income
concepts.description: Per capita income is calculated by dividing national income by the total population. It provides an average measure of income and is commonly used to compare living standards.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to calculate and interpret per capita income.

concepts.name: Economic Planning
concepts.description: Governments use national income data to prepare budgets, formulate development policies, and allocate public resources efficiently.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain how national income statistics support economic planning.

concepts.name: International Comparisons
concepts.description: National income indicators enable comparisons of economic performance and living standards among different countries.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to compare economies using national income indicators.

concepts.name: Monitoring Economic Growth
concepts.description: Changes in national income over time help assess economic growth, productivity, and overall development of a country.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to interpret national income data to evaluate economic growth.

concepts.name: Understanding National Income
concepts.description: This chapter introduces the concepts, measures, methods of estimation, importance, and limitations of national income, highlighting its role in economic analysis and policy formulation.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain national income concepts, apply different methods of estimation, and evaluate its usefulness in measuring economic performance.
